specs: All instructors are American Canoe Association (ACA) certified

Life Jackets Life jackets are provided and must be worn at all times while on the water.

Renters must be 18+ to sign rental agreements
Minors require parent or guardian signature on waiver

blurb: Guests can rent kayaks, paddleboards, and canoes, take private or group lessons, join watersports camps for youth, participate in guided eco-tours, or plan private group outings. The business emphasizes safety with ACA-certified instructors and provides equipment and instruction for all skill levels. Membership packages offer rental and lesson benefits for the season.

highlights: All instructors are American Canoe Association (ACA) certified
Guided tours at three scenic locations on Cayuga Lake
requirements: Allow time for parking, check-in, waivers, life jacket fitting, and getting ready to launch.
If waivers are not completed in advance, they must be completed on-site and will count toward your rental time.
Our staff will help you get set up with your watercraft, paddle, life jacket, basic safety information, route suggestions, and launch guidance.
Life Jackets Life jackets are provided and must be worn at all times while on the water.
Return Time All equipment must be returned by the end of your reserved rental time.

Minors require parent or guardian signature on waiver
Campers must wear USCG-approved lifejackets at all times on water
Campers do not need to know how to swim but must be comfortable in deeper water and willing to get head wet
Aides for campers must be 18+, trained, and fully engaged
groupInfo: Private group outings require at least three weeks' notice and are custom quoted
Group outings can be rentals-only, guided trips, or group lessons
bring: Cell phone on the water for rentals
checkin: Thank you for booking with Paddle-N-More. We’re excited to help you enjoy time on the water. Please read the following important information before your rental. Arrival Time Please arrive at least 15 minutes before your scheduled rental time. Your rental begins at the reserved time, and arriving late may reduce your time on the water.
cancellation: Cancellation & Refund Policy Simple, Strict, but Fair We understand that plans can change, but our policies ensure fairness for both our customers and our business operations. 24 Hours Notice: If you cancel at least 24 hours before your reservation, you will receive a 100% refund.
policies: Cancellation Policy: The Lake Explorer Membership is non-refundable.
We offer a full refund for cancellations made 24 hours or more before your scheduled Sunset SUP Yoga session.
Safety Gear: Weather-appropriate clothing, sunscreen, and any additional items specified in your confirmation email to ensure your safety and comfort.
Our cancellation and refund policy is fair and ensures we have enough time to fill your spot if you cancel.
One Month Advance Cancellation: If you cancel at least one month before the program start date, you will receive a 100% refund.
Contact: To cancel or inquire about your registration, please send an email.
If you do need to cancel, please notify us as early as possible so we can offer your spot to someone else in the community who’d love to join.
Full refund if Paddle-N-More cancels for unsafe conditions; no refunds for less-than-ideal weather
